* White helmet
* Service book
* Invoice hard copy

Despite repeated follow-ups with the showroom team, these items are still pending, and there has been no clear communication or resolution.

We are extremely disappointed with the level of service provided, both before and after delivery. Such delays and lack of accountability are not expected from a reputed brand like TVS.

We request you to:

1. Arrange immediate delivery of all pending items
2. Provide the invoice hard copy without further delay
3. Take necessary action to improve customer service and avoid such experiences in the future

We look forward to your prompt resolution on this matter.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently purchased a new bike from Seven Islands Harley-Davidson Mumbai, and I couldn’t be happier with the entire experience. The service provided by the team was truly exceptional. From the management to the sales team and even the service team, everyone was extremely supportive, professional, and genuinely involved in ensuring the process was smooth and enjoyable.

What really stood out was that it wasn’t just one sales representative attending to us. Even in his absence, other executives and the business head himself were always just one call away, making sure everything was running smoothly for us both pre and post delivery. That level of involvement and commitment is truly commendable.

Their hospitality was absolutely top-notch and made the whole buying experience even more special. The team went above and beyond to make sure every detail was taken care of and that I felt confident and excited about my purchase.

A big thank you to the entire Seven Islands Harley-Davidson Mumbai team for such a fantastic experience. Highly recommended for anyone looking to own a Harley and enjoy world-class service.

featured_reviews.name: Ashish Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
Stepping into seven islands , I wasn’t just entering a dealership I was stepping into a century of American legend. The welcome was immediate and high-energy; the team truly makes you feel like you’re already part of the family, often starting the visit with a casual chat that feels more like a clubhouse than a retail space.
The ambience is pure Harley-Davidson: a perfect blend of industrial grit and premium style. Between the rows of gleaming chrome and the scent of leather, the showroom feels like a tribute to freedom. I especially loved how they’ve integrated brand history into the space. The staff shared incredible stories of how William Harley and the Davidson brothers started it all in a small Milwaukee shed in 1903. Learning about their resilience during the Great Depression and their critical role in supplying motorcycles for WWI and WWII really put the bike’s legacy into perspective.
The bike explanation was equally impressive. My consultant, didn’t just list specs; they explained the "soul" of the machine. We took a deep dive into the Milwaukee-Eight V-Twin engine, covering everything from its iconic rumble to its modern cooling and performance. They walked me through the ergonomics, customisation options, and the peace of mind that comes with the brand’s engineering evolution since those early 1900s prototypes.
Whether you're a long-time rider or just starting your journey, this showroom is a must-visitQ for anyone who appreciates a brand that stays true to its roots while pushing into the future. Highly recommended for any true enthusiast!

featured_reviews.name: dipali bhayje
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Harley at Prabhadevi Mumbai to check out the Harley-Davidson lineup, and I must say the experience was top-notch. From the moment I walked in, the staff was welcoming and highly professional.

A special shoutout to the sales team for their deep technical knowledge and for making the test ride process seamless. They took the time to explain the features and customization options without any sales pressure. The showroom ambiance perfectly captures the Harley spirit. Highly recommended for any biking enthusiast!
